primitives.name: Family Tagging Approximation
primitives.verbatim_quote: > **TAGGING IS APPROXIMATE.** Families come from keyword rules over note prose (title + GSE-application section + verdict line), not from reading each paper.
primitives.assumptions: Tagging relies on heuristic keyword matching rather than semantic parsing.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no GSE-application section is parsed, fallback to verdict line occurs.

layer2.mapping: Each paper's prose is mapped to a family via a fixed set of keyword rules, creating a discrete signal family assignment function F(paper) = family.
layer2.telemetry: Parse coverage rate and number of NOT PARSED rows.

primitives.name: Impact Score Crude
primitives.verbatim_quote: `impact score` is a crude 0-6 strength score over the paper's own stated impact/priority/accuracy wording (quantified claim +3, priority/production/edge wording +2, explicit GSE action +1).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I': 'impact score (integer, 0–6)', 'C': 'quantified claim indicator (binary)', 'P': 'priority/production/edge indicator (binary)', 'A': 'explicit GSE action indicator (binary)'}
primitives.assumptions: Impact is assessed solely through surface-level textual indicators.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Sentence-level matching fails when no qualifying language is present.

layer2.mapping: Impact score I = 3C + 2P + A, derived from lexical presence in GSE-application section or verdict line.
layer2.telemetry: Distribution of scores across papers and proportion of high-scoring vs. low-scoring entries.

primitives.name: Parse Coverage Honest Count
primitives.verbatim_quote: They remain in the CSV with `doc_type=non-paper` so nothing is hidden.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N_{total}': 'total documents scanned (integer)', 'N_{paper}': 'paper notes in scope (integer)', 'N_{parsed}': 'GSE-application sections parsed (integer)', 'N_{unparsed}': 'GSE-application sections not parsed (integer)'}
primitives.assumptions: All documents are accounted for in the CSV regardless of parse status.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unparsed rows do not indicate absence of GSE content but parsing failure.

layer2.mapping: Parse coverage is modeled as a ratio N_parsed/N_total, with N_unparsed indicating parsing gaps.
layer2.telemetry: Count of parsed vs. unparsed GSE-application sections and total document scan volume.
